stories.title: Tool Router Error Handling and Fallback Behavior
stories.description: Implement structured error handling for tool routing, including graceful rejection of non-allowlisted tools, Pydantic validation failures, and safe fallback responses to the LLM without breaking the agent loop.

stories.title: Tool Invocation Logging and Audit Trail
stories.description: Integrate logging of tool routing decisions, including tool name, validation outcome, and execution status, leveraging existing debug_logger infrastructure for traceability and audit compliance.

stories.title: Dynamic Tool Registration and Extensibility Hook
stories.description: Introduce a structured mechanism for registering new tools into the allowlist (e.g., centralized registry or config pattern) while preserving strict validation and governance constraints.
